# Nmap Professional Reference v2.0.0 — Bilingual Edition

This release turns the project into a complete bilingual Persian and English Nmap reference.

## Highlights

- Complete Persian RTL edition under `/fa/`
- Complete English LTR edition under `/en/`
- Matching 14-chapter structure across both languages
- Learning Path, Cheat Sheet, References, and Disclaimer in both editions
- Root language selector for GitHub Pages
- High-quality WebP project branding
- CC BY 4.0 documentation license
- Strict MkDocs builds for both languages
- Automated bilingual structure and local-link integrity checks
- Unit-tested documentation checker

## Documentation

- Persian: https://mmkarii.github.io/nmap-fa-reference/fa/
- English: https://mmkarii.github.io/nmap-fa-reference/en/
- Language selector: https://mmkarii.github.io/nmap-fa-reference/

## Safety and scope

The examples and workflows in this project are intended for education, administration, labs, and authorized security assessments. Run scans only against systems and networks you own or are explicitly authorized to assess.
